title_en: Bachelorhood, Mother, Is Being a Pasha
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Line 1 'наодев' is odd; my reading is 'I found (good things)'. 'кочански' meaning 'like corn cobs' is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: the status of a pasha (grand life)

lines.en: I went about as a bachelor, mother, and found,
I fell in love with pretty girls, mother,
bachelorhood, mother, is being a pasha,
girlhood, mother, is being a vizier.
I fell in love with pretty girls, mother,
all of them looked like white corn cobs, mother,
bachelorhood, mother, is being a pasha,
girlhood, mother, is being a vizier.

lines.cyr: Од сите мамо моми што љубев,
lines.lat: Od site mamo momi što ljubev,
lines.en: Of all the girls, mother, that I loved,

lines.cyr: само ми беше една на срце,
lines.lat: samo mi beše edna na srce,
lines.en: only one was on my heart,
bachelorhood, mother, is being a pasha,
girlhood, mother, is being a vizier.
